_schema: direction_params - learned fertile-frontier regions for BFS first-mover (fresh technique x all-of-life). Append history each session; params steer next session's BFS.
core_lesson_learned: The fertile frontier is NOT 'a life domain with low AI penetration' - any domain with a DOCUMENTED open problem already attracts some ML, and 'obvious' applications are productized within months (varroa-counting apps, timegrapher.ai, MIT painting-restoration, whistled-language ASR all pre-existed). The fertile region is the INTERSECTION: a domain whose EXISTING ML work LACKS the specific capability a fresh technique uniquely provides. Match on CAPABILITY-GAP, not DOMAIN-GAP. And the fresh technique must be the differentiator, not incidental (a backbone/quantizer that 'any model could supply' does not define a first-mover).

ml_subfield_fertility.evidence: SGNO->glassblowing was the closest-to-open (NARROW); physics surrogates are rarely pointed at craft, and crafts have no hobbyist-app market. Caveat: training data must often be simulated.

Toto2.0/Reverso->fermentation survived NARROW because the FOUNDATION-MODEL angle is distinct from bespoke per-domain models / e-nose already used; but VETime->horology CLOSED (anomaly detection on obvious signals gets productized).
SAM-Audio->overtone-stem survived NARROW (separation-into-stems is a capability the domain's visualization tools lack); Audio-Omni->whistled-ASR CLOSED (ASR-type tasks already attempted).
Molmo2->varroa and InternVL-U->painting both CLOSED. Counting/grounding/generative-inpainting get productized fast even in niche domains.

Sparse-BitNet->ethnoveterinary and Mamba-3->wayfinding survived NARROW only because their DOMAINS are under-served - the technique itself is incidental (any small/sequence model would serve). Backbones do not define a first-mover application.

life_domain_fertility.domain: Physics-bearing crafts (glassblowing, kiln firing, forge welding, thermal/viscosity by eye)
life_domain_fertility.why: Real physics (heat/PDE) + no consumer-app market + ML largely absent. Best target for neural-operator / physics-surrogate techniques.

life_domain_fertility.domain: Tacit-sensory fermentation with a DOCUMENTED gap (moromi, koji, balsamic, affinage)
life_domain_fertility.why: Gap is real and literature-admitted, but e-nose/CV already nibbling; only the foundation-model zero-shot FORECASTING angle remains open. Calibration data is the bottleneck.

life_domain_fertility.domain: Performance-craft acoustics (overtone singing, lutherie tap-tone, change ringing, throat singing)
life_domain_fertility.why: Spectrogram visualization tools exist; learned SOURCE-SEPARATION / generation is the unused capability.

life_domain_fertility.domain: Low-resource / offline practice (ethnoveterinary, rural midwifery, herbal)
life_domain_fertility.why: Domains genuinely under-served, BUT offline-LLM-advisor capability already exists generically (Farmer.Chat, Pocket RAG) - the corpus is new, the technique is not. Technique-incidental risk.
Cognitive models (etak) + learned dead-reckoning (AI-IMU) already occupy the framing.

life_domain_fertility.domain: Niche practices WITH a hobbyist/consumer app market (beekeeping varroa, watch regulation, painting restoration, whistled-language ASR)
life_domain_fertility.why: Saturated by shipping apps or recent papers despite looking 'under-served' on Wikipedia. A consumer app market is a strong saturation signal.

avoid_list_saturated_regions: VLM object-counting x beekeeping mite monitoring (VarroDetector, Apizoom, BeeScanning)
TS anomaly-detection x mechanical-watch regulation (timegrapher.ai ships it)
generative inpainting x painting conservation (MIT/Kachkine, Nature 2025)
audio ASR/MLLM x whistled-language transcription (Jakubiak, Interspeech 2023)
watch_list_qualified_narrow: neural-operator forward-rollout x artisan hot-glass viscosity (vs industrial closed-loop control 2604.00135) - thinnest remaining slice, most defensible
learned source-separation-into-stems x overtone/throat-singing pedagogy (vs spectrogram visualizers)
multivariate-TS-foundation-model x in-tank fermentation maturity forecasting (vs e-nose/CV snapshots)
process_improvements_for_next_session: Add an APP-STORE / commercial-product search to Phase-1 life sourcing: ai_penetration ratings that ignore shipping consumer apps were over-optimistic (varroa, horology both had apps the life-agents missed).

In Phase 3 pairing, require the proposer to name the SPECIFIC capability the domain's existing ML lacks (capability-gap), and forbid 'why_no_one_done_it' claims of the form 'no AI in domain X' without a paired negative-search.
Down-weight VLM-counting/grounding/inpainting and generic LLM-backbone/quantization pairings (low fertility, technique-incidental).
Up-weight scientific-ML/neural-operators x physics-bearing crafts (highest fertility this session).

history.headline: Fresh+usable technique x under-served domain still tends to find the application target partially occupied; capability-gap > domain-gap is the steering update.
